input.args: Write the "one more service" argument from notes/issue-70.md into docs/. This argument has come up three times this year (Redis for sessions in 2023 → docs/adr/0001-keep-sessions-in-the-database.md, Redis for Celery in March 2025 → docs/adr/0002-run-background-jobs-on-postgres.md, and now Elasticsearch for search in October 2026, resolved by switching to Postgres full-text search per notes/issue-70.md). Ana (maintainer) stated the rule explicitly in the thread: "larder runs one database and one web app, and a new service has to do something Postgres cannot, with two volunteers able to restore it... It does not mean never: the card gateway is outside, and we would take a hosted service nobody has to run." This is a tenet per docs/README.md's criteria (guides many decisions, each application is its own ADR). docs/philosophy.md does not exist yet — create it with a Tenets section per the docs/README.md spec, linking docs/adr/0001 and docs/adr/0002 as records that apply it. Also decide whether the October 2026 search resolution (Postgres full-text search for pantry item search) needs its own ADR record under docs/adr/ applying the same tenet, consistent with how 0001 and 0002 are structured — if so, write it, numbered 0003, and link it from the tenet and from docs/adr/README.md. Update docs/README.md's new-kind section is not needed since philosophy.md is already a defined kind in the recipe — just write the page itself and its guide if needed. No one is available to answer questions; use only what notes/issue-70.md and the existing docs hold.

last_message:
This reads correctly against the map's spec: one page, a lead (who/what/why), and a `Tenets` section where the tenet rules something out and links the two records that apply it. I left notes/issue-70.md alone since it's not part of `docs/` and the skill doesn't touch trackers — the search decision itself (Postgres full-text search for item lookup) hasn't been implemented yet, so it doesn't get an ADR yet; the next proposal (or the one that lands the search change) can cite this tenet and add its own record.

**Summary:** Created `docs/philosophy.md` with the "one more service earns its place, or it stays out" tenet — Ana's rule from the issue-70 thread (Postgres must be insufficient and two volunteers must be able to restore the new service) plus the stated exception for hosted services like the card gateway. Linked it from `docs/adr/0001` and `docs/adr/0002`, the two prior times the argument was settled, so the next "add a service" proposal starts from the written tenet instead of re-litigating it.
